snippet.title: From TV Animation Slam Dunk - Super Slams Arcade
snippet.description:
From TV Animation Slam Dunk !! is a video game released by Bandai for Arcades on October 27, 1995 exclusively in Japan.
The video game is inspired by manga and anime Slam Dunk and allows the player to control the Shohoku team
